_about: Format registry for the /design-init collateral branch (S5C collateral-spec / S7C collateral-build / S8C collateral-review). One entry per supported collateral type. v1 covers one-pager (the A4 brochure / sell sheet); social-pack / html-email / case-study are reserved for v2+. (Pitch-deck graduated to its own first-class `pitch-deck` track on 2026-05-20 — see .claude/lib/pitch-deck-formats.json; it is no longer a collateral type.) The .claude/pipeline/.collateral-type dotfile holds the active key (pinned to one-pager in v1). There is no shipped layout kit — the build GENERATES each A4 page's layout from the page_archetypes vocabulary below + the S6C direction + imagegen references, skinned entirely from the project's Design.md §2 tokens (the client's design system). This mirrors how the landing-page branch's frontend-build generates layout from the direction rather than porting a fixed kit.

one-pager.label: One-pager / sell sheet
one-pager.summary: A printable A4 marketing brochure that distils the offer to a small number of pages. The classic 'leave-behind' / 'PDF you email'.
one-pager.deliverable: self-contained HTML+CSS file (stacked A4 pages); the editable HTML is the deliverable. An A4 PDF is OPTIONAL and never auto-created — S9C asks the designer whether to render it.
one-pager.ui_kit_note: `ui_kit` is the build-MODE selector (brochure) — NOT a path to a shipped kit (there is none). The build sizes each `.page` to A4 and generates the archetype layouts named in `page_archetypes` from the `archetype_notes` geometry + the S6C direction + imagegen references, skinned from Design.md §2.

size_px._note: A4 at 72dpi; the build sizes .page in mm and lays the interior out in these px values

archetype_notes.CoverPage: dark hero sheet — headline + subhead + a single CTA + the brand watermark
archetype_notes.ContentPage: the mechanism — section headline + intro + a 3-up FeatureRow and/or a hairline DiagnosticList
archetype_notes.StatsPage: the proof — section headline + intro + a 2x2 stat-card grid (optionally a compact comparison strip)
archetype_notes.ClosingPage: the ask — short label/text rows ('how it works') + a dark CtaStrip + a footer row

one-pager.render: html (pdf on request at S9C; S8C measures with --no-pdf, no file)
hard_constraints: every page's content fits within the page box minus print margins — nothing overflows the bottom edge or the stripe/footer
print-to-PDF produces exactly the declared page count (a page that wraps to two = FAIL)
all colours resolve to a Design.md §2 token — off-palette = FAIL
HTML+CSS only — no React/Vue/Tailwind/JS framework, no build step; no motion (static brochure)
fonts: only what Design.md §2 declares (Google-Fonts-or-parent-only, max 2 families)

_deferred_v2.social-pack: 1080x1080 / 1080x1350 / OG 1200x630 fixed-px frames; rendered to PNG; review check = legible at 50% scale; ui_kit social
_deferred_v2.html-email: ~600px content width, table layout, inline styles, email-client-safe; ui_kit email
_deferred_v2.case-study: A4 multi-page (2-6 pages), long-form text + charts; ui_kit case-study (extends brochure)
